'''Diab''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located within the [[Diab system/Legends|Diab system]] of the [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]]. Its [[Diab 6|sixth moon]] was orbited by the secret [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Prison/Legends|prison]] known as [[the Prism]]. Diab's electrical storms wreaked havoc with sensors and no transmissions were allowed in or out of the prison.
